name: shalcon-demo-first-outbound-engine
description: Demo-first outbound engine for Shalcon Intelligence

scripts.dev:web: npm run prepare:templates && npm --workspace @shalcon/web run dev
scripts.dev:runner: cd apps/local-runner && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m shalcon_runner health
scripts.build: npm run prepare:templates && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:templates && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:python: cd apps/local-runner && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest tests -q
scripts.test:phase0:offline: npm run typecheck:foundation && npm run test:python && npm run test:phase0:audit
scripts.test:phase0: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:python && npm run build && npm run test:phase0:audit
scripts.test:phase1: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:phase1:d1 && npm run test:python && npm run build && npm run test:phase1:audit
scripts.test:phase2: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:phase1:d1 && npm run test:phase2:d1 && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:python && npm run build && npm run test:phase0:audit && npm run test:phase1:audit && npm run test:phase2:audit
scripts.test:phase3: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:phase1:d1 && npm run test:phase2:d1 && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:python && npm run build && npm run test:phase0:audit && npm run test:phase1:audit && npm run test:phase2:audit && npm run test:phase3:audit
scripts.test:phase4: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:phase1:d1 && npm run test:phase2:d1 && npm run test:phase4:d1 && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:python && npm run build && npm run test:phase0:audit && npm run test:phase1:audit && npm run test:phase2:audit && npm run test:phase3:audit && npm run test:phase4:audit
